name: Castle Peak Holdings Public Company Limited
summary: Castle Peak Holdings Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and exports garments in Thailand. It operates in two segments, Garment Manufacturing, and Development of Real Estate for Sale. The company primarily offers jackets, coats, trousers, and sportswear under the customer's trademark. It exports its garments to the United States and the European Union. Castle Peak Holdings Public Company Limited was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
